title: Number of Lines To Write String
description: Calculate the number of lines and the width of the last line when writing a string into lines with a maximum width of 100.
pseudocode:
1. lines = 1, currentWidth = 0
2. for char in s:
3.   width = widths[char.charCodeAt(0) - 97]
4.   if currentWidth + width > 100:
5.     lines++, currentWidth = width
6.   else:
7.     currentWidth += width
8. return [lines, currentWidth]

steps.note: Initialize lines to 1 and currentWidth to 0.
Check if 20 + 90 > 100. It is, so move to new line.
Increment lines to 2 and reset currentWidth to 90.
